title: Only immortal mace
description: Now mace is only one and can survive even the Void
body:
This datapack/mod makes mace basically immortal. Recipe is now dragon egg for heavy core. Mace gets glowing, cant burn or despawn and ever die to a cactus

Also, Mace has void protection. When mace is on y</=-63 it strikes lightning, teleports to 0 100 0 (also with lightning) and server tells everyone that the Mace is on spawn. This works in every dimension, even if you died to void holding it.

Hope this datapack will make your smp more interesting!
